label: Teltonika RUT360
description: Industrial 4G Cat 6 router: 1x 100 Mbps WAN, 1x 100 Mbps LAN, Wi-Fi.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT360 datasheet: **2 x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports** (one WAN, one LAN) with an LTE Cat 6 modem and Wi-Fi. **Cat 6 cellular behind fast Ethernet** - the radio can outrun the ports, so on a good cell the LAN side is the limit.
